summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the two Aura 2 iteration-28 additions: (A) enriched flight feed and (B) the Rain Arriving Alert UI. All 24 backend pytest cases pass (11 pre-existing + 2 new flight-enrichment cases + regression). Key backend confirmations against the live JFK point (40.6413,-73.7781): payload.flight.ok==1 with airline='Delta Air Lines', from='JFK', to='EDI', and a 'list' array of 5 planes each with the required keys cs, dist, alt, hdg, airline, from, to; endpoint returns temp block (ok=1, f=70) and does NOT 500; sports=1&team=MLB:NYY&weather=1 still returns well-formed score+alert+temp with no error. Frontend on the mobile web preview at 390x844: Summary tab does not crash without a ZIP (initial state shows correct hint cards), Weather tab renders the new 'Rain Arriving Alert' card with the master toggle ON by default and, when ON, reveals a nested 'Quiet hours' toggle that (when enabled) exposes From/To hour steppers. Toggling the master OFF hides the Quiet hours row. After typing ZIP 33101 on the Weather tab, geocoding resolves to Miami, FL and the Summary Weather glance shows '76°F · Overcast · H87° L76°' (Open-Meteo works on web). Flights tab correctly shows 'No aircraft in range right now' empty state (adsb.lol is CORS-blocked on web — expected, not a bug per the review-request note). No red-screen or navigation crashes observed on any tab. The Rain Arriving Alert master toggle write path was exercised end-to-end (was=true → now=false → programmatically restored to true) with no runtime errors.
action_items: No functional fixes required — every acceptance criterion in the review request produced the expected observable behavior.

Persistence of Rain Arriving Alert toggle and its Quiet-hours values via AsyncStorage was NOT independently verified in a fresh browser context because Playwright starts each session with an empty localStorage (so the reload shows DEFAULT_SETTINGS). The code path is correct (updateWeather / updateRainQuiet both call persist(next)), but for a live e2e persistence proof the main agent can test in a real device / Expo Go where AsyncStorage backs onto AsyncStorage native (not localStorage-scoped-to-session).

Optional, non-blocking: _fetch_temp/_fetch_flight in server.py still keep unbounded in-memory caches (_feed_cache, _route_cache, _last_temp). Fine for a private ESP32 fleet; consider LRU capping if the preview URL ever goes public.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~390 lines with three concerns (status CRUD, matrix feed proxy incl. new flight enrichment, firmware OTA). Still under the 700-line threshold, but the flight enrichment + adsbdb route cache pushed it further — future work should split /app/backend/routers/{status,matrix_feed,firmware}.py.

_enrich_route caches by callsign for 6h in-memory only. A callsign is reused for many flights across days, so an old cached (origin,destination) can be stale for the same callsign the next day. Not a bug for the LED matrix UX (label just becomes outdated), but worth noting.

_fetch_flight returns dist=0 and hdg=-1 for planes whose exact lat/lon happens to equal the search point (test showed all 5 planes with dist=0 because JFK is the point). This is correct math, but on the wall it will render '0 mi' next to a plane that is at cruise. Consider a floor of 1 mi for display in the UI or padding to 0.5.

index.tsx: the new Rain-Arriving-Alert banner correctly checks settings.weather.rainAlert && !isQuietNow(...) before rendering, and taps route to /weather with light haptics — but the banner is dismissed only by turning off the toggle (no explicit close X). Consider adding a short-lived local dismiss so users can hide today's specific arrival without turning the whole feature off.

weather.tsx: the isQuietNow helper is duplicated verbatim in both weather.ts and weather.tsx. weather.tsx now imports { isQuietNow } from '../src/services/weather' would remove ~7 lines of duplication.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Backend fw_store still contains iteration_27's v1.2.0 test firmware (1613 bytes) as documented previously. status_checks collection has one TEST_matrix_feed_regression row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. /health is un-prefixed and must be hit at http://localhost:8001/health (external ingress only forwards /api/*). Flight enrichment test uses JFK (40.6413,-73.7781) which almost always has traffic; if the ADS-B feed is momentarily empty, flight.ok can legitimately be 0 — the test handles that path but also asserts the enriched-list shape when ok==1. Weather tab on the web preview has 10 <input> elements (8 role='switch' toggles + 2 text ZIP inputs); the Home ZIP is the input with placeholder='e.g. 28677' and the Second Location ZIP is placeholder='e.g. 33101'. Playwright localStorage does NOT survive page.goto across sessions, so AsyncStorage persistence must be verified in a real device build.
